paragraphs: Huna, son of Rav Nachman, also called Rav Huna bar Nachman and Huna Mar bar Nachman. Rav Pappa kissed his head and gave him his daughter: Horayot 12b. Rav Huna bar Chinena: Chullin 49b; see there; they disagree with Rava. Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman said to him. Mar Huna, son of Rav Nachman, said to Rav Ashi: Bava Metzia 47a.
